newsitem.title: UK: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 8.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - London-based Arab newspapers - Dec 8.

text.p: These are some of the leading stories in two London-based Arabic-language newspapers on Sunday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Bahrain says it boycotted Gulf Arab summit because Qatar has threatened its security.
- Germany gives Palestinians $32 million in aid.
- Yemen allocates 74 billion rials in 1997 budget to support wheat, electricity and water.
- Iraqi trade minister visits Jordan on Sunday. Jordanian businessmen seek to increase trade with Iraq to $400 million.
- Four Saudi electricity companies lose one billion riyals in six months.
- Three Israeli firms to participate in a weapons exhibition in Jordan.
